items.evidence: All four labware loaded with the specified load names, slots and labels; p20 left and p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Loop aspirates 18 µL from reservoir A1 and dispenses into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells; end_state:pcr_plate check passed. The p20 is used for 18 µL, which is within its range.
1 µL aspirated from each colony well and dispensed into the matching PCR well, then p20.mix(3, 10, dest); end-state checks passed.
1 µL aspirated from each primer well and dispensed into the matching PCR well, giving 20 µL total; primer_plate end-state check passed.

Fresh tip per colony and per primer. One tip is reused for all 96 master mix dispenses, and it is dispensed with the tip not touching liquid, which is acceptable. The no_cross_contamination check passed.
The step 4 comment records sealing and the full program: 98C 30 s; 30x [98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.

The 1 µL steps use the p20 and the mix volume is 10 µL, which is sensible. Dispensing 18 µL into dry wells and blowing out at the top is fine. The mix is done in 19 µL, and a full 18 µL aspirate with a single p20 is near its limit. No flow rates or heights are set.
The protocol follows the task order and quantities and invents nothing. The metadata and comments are accurate, and the 3x mix matches the task.

judge.summary: The protocol meets the deck, volume and pairing requirements, and all measured checks passed. It uses fresh tips for each colony and primer addition and records the thermocycling program in a comment. Minor deductions are for reusing one tip for the master mix step and for not setting pipetting heights or flow rates.
